messages.subject: Plot vector field?
parts:
Suppose I have a data.frame that has 4 columns, x, y, vx and vy.

x and y stand for the coordinate of a particle.
vx and vy stand for the velocity of the particle.

I want to plot a set of vectors. Each vector corresponds to one row in
the data.frame, where the start point is (x,y) and the end point is
(x+vx*alpha,y+vy*alpha). Is there a way to do so in ggplot2?
